title: 第一卷 第108章 摊子被砸了！

第(1/3)页

“顺子，这到底是怎么一回事？”

王建军骑着摩托车，忍不住问道。

“这事三两句也说不清楚，我们家老板也已经在县里了。”

“王兄弟，你到那之后就知道了，我也不是很清楚，要不是我家老板不知道你们家在哪，他自己就过来了。”

顺子也不敢有丝毫隐瞒，把自己知道的一五一十的都说了。

但他也是临时被郝大能叫起来的，只知道出了事，但具体什么事，他也不是很清楚。

王建军点了点头，虽然心中有诸多疑惑，但也没有再开口。

两个人一路无话，都加快速度往县里赶了过去。

原本王建军想着该去哪儿找郝大能，没想到他刚到县里，就碰到了一直在那等他的郝大能。

只是让他意外的是，郝大能身边还有个人。

离得近了，王建军才看清楚，那人不是别人，正是白天晴。

这大晚上的，他们两个人怎么会碰到一块。

“王兄弟，这个事是天晴先发现的，她第一时间找到了我，我们两个人心里着急，干脆一块来这等你了。”

郝大能看出了王建军心中的疑惑，率先开口解释道。

王建军点了点头，扭头看向白天晴。

“天晴，这到底是怎么一回事？”

白天晴皱着眉，把自己今天晚上发现的事都说了出来。

“原本我每天晚上都会去咱们白天摆放的摊子那看看，生怕有什么东西落在那了，我今天也照常去了。”

说到这儿，白天晴停了一下，像是想到了什么可怕的事情一样，抿了抿嘴。

而王建军和郝大能也是头一回知道，原来白天晴在他们看不到的地方，为百味鲜虾馆做了这么多事情。

只不过白天晴向来不邀功，要不是这次出了事，怕是他们一直都不知道。

“没事，看到什么就直说，天塌下来有我顶着呢。”

王建军出口安抚道。

如今的白天晴，也只不过是一个二十出头的女孩，还没经历过什么事，远不如上一世那么强大，此时也会感到害怕。

白天晴点了点头，深吸了一口气，这才把看到的事说了出来。

“我今天到那儿的时候，却发现咱们摆在那儿的桌子椅子都被人给弄坏了。”

“有的地方虽然没坏，但是也被泼了许多不明东西，臭的很，就连咱们制作的那些横幅都被踩的七零八落的。”

“我不知道他们那些人还在不在那，也不敢上前，便立刻去找郝老板了。”

白天晴说着，手指不安的搅在一起。

她还没有见过这么卑鄙的手段，一时之间被吓到了。

而郝大能虽然是第二次听到这些话，但依旧十分生气。

“王兄弟，刚才我跟天晴也去看过了，咱们那摊子算是毁了。”

“这群人真是恶毒的很，还好天晴发现的及时，不然明天早上咱们再过去，怕是就晚了。”

郝大能这么个温和性子的人，此时都被气的想要骂人了。

对方这手段真是够肮脏的，看着他们鲜虾馆生意好，就用这种下三滥的手段。

王建军虽然没说话，但眉头也是皱在了一起。

他知道，百味鲜虾馆早晚会被人盯上，却没想到竟然这么快，而且这么迅速。

"Shunzi, what on earth is going on?"

Wang Jianjun couldn't help but ask while riding a motorcycle.

"I can't explain this matter clearly in a few words. Our boss is already in the county."

"Brother Wang, you will know when you get there. I don't know very well either. If my boss didn't know where your house is, he would have come here himself."

Shunzi didn't dare to hide anything and told everything he knew.

But he was also called up by Hao Daneng temporarily. He only knew that something happened, but he didn't know what it was.

Wang Jianjun nodded. Although he had many doubts in his heart, he did not speak again.

The two of them were silent all the way, and both speeded up and rushed towards the county.

Originally, Wang Jianjun was thinking about where to find Hao Daneng, but he didn't expect that as soon as he arrived in the county, he met Hao Daneng, who had been waiting for him.

What surprised him was that there was someone beside Hao Daneng.

As he got closer, Wang Jianjun saw clearly that the person was none other than Tian Tianqing.

How could the two of them bump into each other this late at night?

"Brother Wang, Tianqing discovered this first. She found me immediately. The two of us were anxious, so we might as well come here to wait for you."

Hao Daneng saw the doubts in Wang Jianjun's heart and took the lead in explaining.

Wang Jianjun nodded and turned to look at Bai Tianqing.

"Tian Qing, what on earth is going on?"

Bai Tianqing frowned and told everything she had discovered tonight.

"Originally, I would go to the stall we set up during the day every night to take a look, for fear that something might be left there, so I went as usual today."

Having said this, Bai Tianqing paused for a moment, and pursed her lips as if she had thought of something terrible.

Wang Jianjun and Hao Daneng also knew for the first time that Tian Qing had done so many things for Baiwei Shrimp Restaurant in a place where they could not see.

It's just that Bai Tianqing never takes credit. If it hadn't happened this time, they might never have known about it.

"It's okay. If you see anything, just say it. If the sky falls, I will hold it up."

Wang Jianjun said comfortingly.

Today's Bai Tianqing is just a girl in her early twenties. She has not experienced anything yet. She is far less powerful than in her previous life. She will also feel scared at this time.

Bai Tianqing nodded, took a deep breath, and then told what he saw.

"When I got there today, I found that the tables and chairs we put there had been damaged."

"Although some places were not damaged, a lot of unknown things were thrown at them, and the smell was very bad. Even the banners we made were trampled to pieces."

"I didn't know if those people were still there, and I didn't dare to come forward, so I immediately went to find Boss Hao."

Tian Qing said, her fingers tangled together uneasily.

She had never seen such a despicable method and was frightened for a moment.

Although it was the second time Hao Daneng heard these words, he was still very angry.

"Brother Wang, Tianqing and I went to see it just now. Our stall was destroyed."

"These people are really vicious. Fortunately Tianqing found out in time, otherwise we would have been too late if we had gone there tomorrow morning."

Hao Daneng, a gentle-tempered person, was so angry that he wanted to curse.

The other party's methods were really dirty. Seeing that their shrimp restaurant was doing well, they resorted to such dirty methods.

Although Wang Jianjun said nothing, his brows were furrowed.

He knew that Baiwei Shrimp Restaurant would be targeted sooner or later, but he didn't expect it to happen so quickly and so quickly.
